name: Kaoru Cocoa
description: A calm, serif WordPress theme designed for artisanal chocolatiers and cocoa cafes, inspired by minimalist Japanese patisserie sites. Built around an hour-keyed sticky photo plate, staggered outline card walls, and vertical phrase strips, it highlights small-batch morning tempering and afternoon counter service. Includes booking-led layouts for seated cocoa tastings, weekend cake collections, and seasonal single-origin price lists.
